notes: ἕως ἄν → till is one aligned unit under rule 50; leaving ἄν unrepresented is the failure that rule names, and MAT.10.11 and MAT.10.23 read it the same way.
in no wise is kept whole on the οὐ μή pair under rule 33, headed on the English no, and not split across the particles.
τῶν → of them and ἑστώτων → that stand split under rule 32, the article supplying the pronoun and the participle keeping the relativizer; ὅτι is unrepresented as recitative (rule 43).
